arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Bowker stated that the opposing sides do not dispute the government's authority to fund programs.
Mr. Srinivasan argued that Congress includes an anti-prostitution policy to combat HIV and AIDS.
Mr. Srinivasan cited the Regan case to support a rationality standard for funding conditions.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the boundary between government funding and compelled speech. It determines whether recipients must adopt government policies to receive aid. The outcome shapes how federal grants interact with private expression.
